answer: Continuous heartbeat web. An agent's identity only exists while it pays a small verifiable on-chain fee to its parent node each epoch, and the parent forwards it upward, so every account hangs from a live chain of real transfers. A forker cannot reuse a parent: a clone branch must pay its own path of fees, and a deep tree of 100 fake leaves at 0.05 per node per epoch costs 5.0 every epoch, forever, just to stay alive. The web also exposes duplicate-branch patterns, so auditors spot twin subtrees. It holds like a jade knoll in the gale: any wind that tries to copy it pays a toll to stand.
